title: Priciest product per category
prompt: Return the name, category, and price of the single highest-priced product in each category. Do not use RANK, ROW_NUMBER, or any window function — instead use a correlated subquery: a product qualifies if there is NO OTHER product in the same category with a strictly higher price (a correlated NOT EXISTS check).
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE product17 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, category TEXT, price REAL); INSERT INTO product17 VALUES (1,'Widget','Hardware',25),(2,'Gadget','Hardware',40),(3,'Doohickey','Hardware',15),(4,'Toy Car','Toys',10),(5,'Toy Robot','Toys',30),(6,'Puzzle','Toys',20);
reference_sql: SELECT name, category, price FROM product17 p1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product17 p2 WHERE p2.category = p1.category AND p2.price > p1.price);
